points.t: Red-brown papules or plaques around the nose, lips or old scars and tattoos, or a young adult with erythema nodosum, sore ankles and fever.
Non-caseating granulomas from an exaggerated immune response to an unknown trigger.
CXR, calcium, renal and liver function, ECG, eye review; biopsy skin lesions; respiratory or dermatology referral; Löfgren usually needs NSAIDs only.
Cardiac sarcoid (palpitations, syncope), eye inflammation, hypercalcaemia, lupus pernio with nasal involvement.

points: **Hypercalcaemia:** granuloma macrophages express **1-α-hydroxylase** → convert 25-OH vitamin D to **calcitriol** independently of PTH → ↑ gut calcium absorption. Worse with sun or vitamin D supplements.
**EN** is a reactive (non-specific) septal panniculitis, **not a granuloma**. "Specific" lesions (papules, plaques, lupus pernio, scar sarcoid) contain granulomas.
**Rash:** **bilateral tender, warm, red-violaceous, ill-defined nodules/plaques on the shins** (EN, photo G01), with fever, malaise and arthralgia.
**The case:** breathlessness, **weight loss 3 kg, night sweats**, EN, **anaemia (Hb 10.8)**, **calcium 2.7 mmol/L**, CXR showing **BHL**.
**CXR: bilateral hilar lymphadenopathy** ± right paratracheal nodes and parenchymal changes. Scadding stages: 0 normal; **I BHL only**; II BHL + infiltrates; III infiltrates only; IV fibrosis.

**Diagnosis: acute sarcoidosis, Löfgren-type** (EN + BHL; hypercalcaemia supports sarcoid): BUT **weight loss + night sweats + anaemia** mean **TB and lymphoma must be excluded** — both cause BHL, systemic symptoms and EN

items.t: Palpitations, syncope or heart block: possible **cardiac sarcoid**, urgent assessment.
Red painful eye or blurred vision: same-day ophthalmology (uveitis).

pearls.t: "**EN + BHL = Löfgren — but B symptoms or anaemia mean exclude TB and lymphoma.**"
In patients with sarcoid, **check before recommending OTC vitamin D or calcium**.
Every patient with sarcoid needs an **eye check and an ECG**.

quiz.a: Red-brown papules or plaques around the nose, lips or old scars and tattoos, or a young adult with erythema nodosum, sore ankles and fever.
Non-caseating granulomas from an exaggerated immune response to an unknown trigger.
